**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%8F%AC-%EB%8D%94-%ED%94%84%EB%A6%B0%EC%84%B8%EC%8A%A4/1420), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/51807554)

Can the first love I met again as the prince of the theme park come true? Yeon-hwa, the main character who has been more than herself since childhood. Even though Ji-hoo, the male protagonist who was his first love, confessed that he liked him, I refused because I knew the hearts of other friends who like Ji-hoo. So Yeon-hwa's first love ended in a blur. On the other hand, Yeon-hwa, a good daughter who always came to her mother's words well, became a college student. Just as you treat a child, you want to be independent of a mother who interferes with her life one by one. I will enter the theme park performance stage that I have wanted to do since I was young. I want to be recognized by my mother for what I want to do. Ji-hoo, his first love, appears in front of Yeon-hwa, who is trying to work hard. With Jihoo, who has already settled down at the performance stage and plays Prince Shatten. Yeon-hwa, who played the role of Princess Ekla, who works together. It was awkward at first, but it was the aftermath of my first love that didn't come true. Two people who increasingly have feelings about each other. A ban on dating that performers should not date unconditionally, The male protagonist who takes care of himself like his brother from an early age. a mind about the softening of Jinseong, Yeonhwa and Jihoo, such as the interference of rival glass, Can we overcome all these obstacles and continue?
